john1.5.p1.b1.text: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father also loves those born of Him.

john1.5.p1.b2.text: … And this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.

john1.5.p1.b4.text: Only he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.

john1.5.p2.b1.text: This is the One who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ—not by water alone, but by water and blood. …

john1.5.p2.b2.text: the Spirit, the water, and the blood—and these three are in agreement.

john1.5.p2.b3.text: Whoever believes in the Son of God has this testimony within him; …

john1.5.p3.b1.text: I have written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.

john1.5.p3.b2.text: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.

john1.5.p3.b3.text: And this is the confidence that we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.

john1.5.p4.b1.text: If anyone sees his brother committing a sin not leading to death, he should ask God, who will give life to those who commit this kind of sin. …

john1.5.p4.b2.text: All unrighteousness is sin, yet there is sin that does not lead to death.

john1.5.p5.b1.text: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know Him who is true; …

john1.5.p5.b2.text: We know that we are of God, and that the whole world is under the power of the evil one.

john1.5.p5.b3.text: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
